candidates.titulo: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
candidates.resumen:
OpenAI is facing a new wave of lawsuits from eight US states that accuse the company of harming children and misleading customers about the safety of ChatGPT, as reported earlier by Reuters. The lawsuits, filed separately by Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho, and Montana, allege OpenAI unlawfully put profits over safety when developing ChatGPT.

candidates.titulo: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
candidates.resumen: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as AI involved in composition and vocals.

candidates.titulo: YouTube sticks new labels on AI-generated songs
candidates.resumen: YouTube is adding a "Made with AI" label to tracks that were "altered or fully generated" using AI, with a similar approach to its existing process for applying AI labels to videos. It doesn't sound like this will apply to any and all use of AI tools in making music, but according to YouTube, it includes things like "using a generative model to create the composition and vocals."
